semiconductor_relevance: High — Sigasi provides specialized design software for chip designers, focusing on VHDL/SystemVerilog platforms that enhance the design and verification processes.
summary: Sigasi develops advanced Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools that streamline the chip design process for FPGA and ASIC designers. Their Visual HDL platform integrates with VS Code, offering features that improve design insights and error detection early in the design cycle, ultimately saving time and reducing costs.
capabilities: Visual HDL Designer Edition for VHDL/SystemVerilog design
Visual HDL Professional Edition with verification and visualization tools
Visual HDL Enterprise Edition for integrated design and verification workflows
technical_expertise: Integrated development environments (IDEs) for hardware design
